description.en: The Dunlop CX 200 2024 is a control-oriented performance racquet designed for advanced players seeking precision, feel and stability in a more forgiving package than the CX 200 TOUR. Its 98 sq.in head, 305 g unstrung weight and 315 mm head-light balance provide excellent maneuverability and confidence from both the baseline and the net. SONIC CORE with Infinergy improves rebound and vibration absorption, VIBROSHIELD enhances comfort and feel, POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ supports spin and power, while CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY improves stability and swing-through.
description.zh: Dunlop CX 200 2024 是一款偏控制与精准的高性能球拍，采用98平方英寸拍面、305克空拍重量及315毫米头轻平衡设计。相比 CX 200 TOUR，它更容易驾驭，同时仍保持出色的稳定性、击球手感与线路控制。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹与减震表现，VIBROSHIELD 改善舒适性，POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ 增强旋转与力量表现，而 CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY 则进一步提升拍框稳定性与挥拍效率。适合高级底线型及全场型球员。

description.en: The Dunlop CX 200 LS 2024 is a lightweight control-oriented performance racquet featuring a 98 sq.in head, 290 g unstrung weight and 325 mm head-light balance. It is designed for intermediate to advanced players seeking faster maneuverability without giving up precision and stability. SONIC CORE with Infinergy improves rebound and vibration absorption, VIBROSHIELD enhances comfort and feel, POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ supports spin and power, while CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY improves stability and swing-through.
description.zh: Dunlop CX 200 LS 2024 是一款轻量化控制型高性能球拍，采用98平方英寸拍面、290克空拍重量及325毫米头轻平衡设计。相比标准 CX 200 更容易挥动，适合希望提升挥拍速度、灵活性与快速反应，同时仍保留精准控制和稳定性的中高级球员。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹和减震表现，VIBROSHIELD 改善舒适性与手感，POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ 增强旋转及力量，而 CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY 则进一步提升拍框稳定性与挥拍效率。

description.en: The Dunlop CX 200 OS 2024 is an oversize control-oriented performance racquet featuring a 105 sq.in head, 295 g unstrung weight and 325 mm head-light balance. It offers a larger sweet spot, improved forgiveness and excellent comfort without losing the precision and feel associated with the CX family. SONIC CORE with Infinergy enhances rebound and vibration absorption, VIBROSHIELD improves comfort and control on off-center hits, POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ increases spin and power, while CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY improves stability and swing-through.
description.zh: Dunlop CX 200 OS 2024 是 CX 系列中的大拍面控制型球拍，采用105平方英寸拍面、295克空拍重量及325毫米头轻平衡设计。相比标准 CX 200，它拥有更大的甜区、更高的容错率与更舒适的击球体验，同时仍保留 CX 系列强调的精准控制与手感。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹与减震表现，VIBROSHIELD 改善偏心击球时的舒适性与控制，POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ 增强旋转与力量，而 CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY 则进一步提升稳定性与挥拍效率。

description.en: The Dunlop CX 200 TOUR 16x19 2024 is a tour-level control racquet designed for advanced players seeking precision, feel and greater spin access than the 18x20 version. Its 95 sq.in head, 315 g unstrung weight and 315 mm slightly head-light balance provide exceptional stability and confidence on aggressive swings. SONIC CORE with Infinergy improves rebound and vibration absorption, VIBROSHIELD enhances comfort and feel, POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ supports spin and power, while CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY improves stability and swing-through.
description.zh: Dunlop CX 200 TOUR 16x19 2024 是一款高阶竞技控制型球拍，采用95平方英寸拍面、315克空拍重量、315毫米略偏头轻平衡及16×19线床。相比18×20版本，它在保持极高精准度与稳定性的同时，提供更好的旋转潜力和更灵活的击球弹道。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹与减震表现，VIBROSHIELD 改善舒适性与手感，POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ 增强旋转与力量，而 CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY 则进一步提升拍框稳定性与挥拍效率。非常适合高水平底线进攻及全场型球员。

description.en: The Dunlop CX 200 TOUR 18x20 2024 is a tour-level control racquet built for advanced players seeking maximum precision, feel and directional consistency. Its compact 95 sq.in head, 315 g unstrung weight, 310 mm head-light balance and dense 18x20 string pattern provide exceptional stability and control. SONIC CORE with Infinergy improves rebound and vibration absorption, VIBROSHIELD enhances comfort and feel, POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ supports spin and power, while CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY improves stability and precision through the swing.
description.zh: Dunlop CX 200 TOUR 18x20 2024 是一款面向高水平及比赛型球员的极致控制型球拍。它采用95平方英寸拍面、315克空拍重量、310毫米头轻平衡、18×20密集线床以及20.5毫米恒定薄框设计，强调精准落点、稳定性与细腻击球反馈。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹与减震表现，VIBROSHIELD 改善舒适性与手感，POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ 增强击球表现，而 CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY 则进一步提升拍框稳定性与挥拍过程中的精准度。

description.en: The Dunlop CX 400 2024 is a lightweight control-oriented racquet featuring a 100 sq.in head, 285 g unstrung weight and 330 mm head-light balance. It is designed for intermediate and improving players who want easier maneuverability without losing control, comfort or useful power. SONIC CORE with Infinergy improves rebound and vibration absorption, VIBROSHIELD enhances feel and comfort, POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ supports spin and power, while CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY improves stability and swing-through.
description.zh: Dunlop CX 400 2024 是一款轻量化控制型球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、285克空拍重量及330毫米头轻平衡设计。它非常适合希望提升操控速度，同时又不想牺牲控制、舒适性与力量表现的中级及进阶球员。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹与减震表现，VIBROSHIELD 改善击球手感与舒适性，POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ 增强旋转与力量，而 CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY 则进一步提升稳定性与挥拍效率。

description.en: The Dunlop CX 400 TOUR 2024 is a versatile control-oriented performance racquet featuring a 100 sq.in head, 300 g unstrung weight and 320 mm slightly head-light balance. It blends control, power, comfort and stability in a more forgiving package than the smaller-headed CX 200 models. SONIC CORE with Infinergy improves rebound and vibration absorption, VIBROSHIELD enhances comfort and feel, POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ supports spin and power, while CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY improves stability and swing-through.
description.zh: Dunlop CX 400 TOUR 2024 是一款兼顾控制、力量与舒适性的高性能球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量及320毫米略偏头轻平衡设计。相比拍面更小的 CX 200 系列，它拥有更好的容错率与更容易获得的力量，同时仍保持 CX 系列强调的精准控制与稳定性。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹与减震表现，VIBROSHIELD 改善舒适性与手感，POWERGRID STRINGTECH+ 增强旋转与力量，而 CONTROL FRAME GEOMETRY 则进一步提升拍框稳定性与挥拍效率。

description.en: The Dunlop FX 500 2026 is a modern power racquet featuring a 100 sq.in head, 300 g unstrung weight and a 16x19 string pattern. Designed for players seeking effortless pace, easy depth and comfortable power while maintaining solid maneuverability.
description.zh: Dunlop FX 500 2026 是 FX 系列的核心力量型球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量、320mm平衡点及16×19线床，为追求轻松击球深度、强劲力量及舒适击球感的中高级球员打造，同时保持良好的挥拍速度与操控性。

description.en: The Dunlop FX 500 Tour 2026 is a tour-level power racquet featuring a 98 sq.in head, 305 g unstrung weight and a 16x19 string pattern. It offers explosive power with greater precision and stability for advanced players.
description.zh: Dunlop FX 500 Tour 2026 是 FX 系列职业版力量型球拍，采用98平方英寸拍面、305克空拍重量、315mm平衡点及16×19线床，在保留 FX 系列爆发力的同时，提供更高的精准度、稳定性与击球控制，适合高水平竞技球员。

description.en: The Dunlop SX 300 2025 is a performance-focused spin racquet featuring a 100 sq.in head, 300 g unstrung weight and 320 mm slightly head-light balance. SONIC CORE with Infinergy improves rebound, vibration absorption and comfort, while SPIN BOOST XT GROMMETS and SPIN BOOST FRAME GEOMETRY enhance spin, power and shot consistency. V-ENERGY SHAFT increases stability and swing speed, while VIBROSHIELD reduces unwanted vibration. It is designed for intermediate to advanced players seeking a balanced combination of spin, explosive power and control.
description.zh: Dunlop SX 300 2025 是 SX 系列的核心旋转型球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量及320毫米略偏头轻平衡设计。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹表现、减震能力与舒适性；SPIN BOOST XT GROMMETS 与 SPIN BOOST FRAME GEOMETRY 强化旋转、力量及击球稳定性；V-ENERGY SHAFT 提升拍框稳定性与挥拍速度；VIBROSHIELD 则进一步降低不必要的震动。整体定位为旋转、力量与控制均衡，适合中级至高级的现代底线及全场型球员。

description.en: The Dunlop SX 300 LITE 2025 is a lightweight spin-oriented racquet featuring a 100 sq.in head, 270 g unstrung weight and 330 mm balance. Designed for beginner and intermediate players, it provides quick maneuverability, easy acceleration and strong spin potential. SONIC CORE with Infinergy improves comfort and rebound, SPIN BOOST XT GROMMETS and SPIN BOOST FRAME GEOMETRY enhance spin and power, V-ENERGY SHAFT improves stability and swing speed, while VIBROSHIELD reduces unwanted vibration.
description.zh: Dunlop SX 300 LITE 2025 是 SX 系列中的轻量旋转型球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、270克空拍重量及330毫米平衡点，适合初学者及中级球员。球拍具备非常灵活的挥拍表现、轻松的加速能力以及优秀的旋转潜力。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹与舒适性；SPIN BOOST XT GROMMETS 与 SPIN BOOST FRAME GEOMETRY 增强旋转和力量；V-ENERGY SHAFT 提升稳定性与挥拍速度；VIBROSHIELD 则帮助减少不必要的震动。

description.en: The Dunlop SX 300 LS 2025 is a lightweight spin-oriented performance racquet featuring a 100 sq.in head, 285 g unstrung weight, 325 mm balance and a 16x19 string pattern. It combines exceptional maneuverability, explosive spin and impressive comfort, making it an excellent choice for intermediate and advanced players seeking a fast-swinging modern racquet.
description.zh: Dunlop SX 300 LS 2025 是 SX 系列轻量级旋转型球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、285克空拍重量、325毫米平衡点及16×19线床。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提供优秀的减震与回弹表现；SPIN BOOST XT GROMMETS 与 SPIN BOOST FRAME GEOMETRY 带来更强旋转和更高容错率；V-ENERGY SHAFT 提高挥拍速度与稳定性；VIBROSHIELD 则进一步提升舒适性。整体定位为轻量、高旋转、易挥拍，适合希望提升挥拍速度和旋转质量的中高级球员。

description.en: The Dunlop SX 300 TOUR 2025 is a competitive spin-focused racquet featuring a 98 sq.in head, 305 g unstrung weight and 315 mm head-light balance. SONIC CORE with Infinergy enhances rebound and vibration absorption, while SPIN BOOST XT GROMMETS and SPIN BOOST FRAME GEOMETRY increase spin potential and explosive shot production. V-ENERGY SHAFT improves stability and swing-through speed, while VIBROSHIELD helps reduce unwanted vibration for greater comfort and control.
description.zh: Dunlop SX 300 TOUR 2025 是一款面向高水平竞技球员的旋转型球拍，采用98平方英寸拍面、305克空拍重量及315毫米头轻平衡设计。SONIC CORE with Infinergy 提升回弹表现并吸收震动；SPIN BOOST XT GROMMETS 与 SPIN BOOST FRAME GEOMETRY 进一步增强旋转和爆发力；V-ENERGY SHAFT 提升稳定性与挥拍速度；VIBROSHIELD 则帮助降低震动，在高速对抗中提供更好的舒适性与控制。整体定位是旋转、控制与力量之间的高性能平衡，适合主动进攻型底线球员及比赛型选手。

description.en: The Lacoste L23 Light is a lightweight collaboration racquet developed with Tecnifibre, designed to deliver comfort, forgiveness and easy maneuverability. Weighing 275 g unstrung with a 320 mm balance and 16x19 string pattern, it is particularly suitable for beginner and intermediate players seeking effortless handling and controllable power. Its variable-density string pattern is tighter around the ideal hitting zone and more open toward the edges, helping combine tolerance, comfort and power.
description.zh: Lacoste L23 Light 是 Lacoste 与 Tecnifibre 联合开发的轻量化联名球拍，主打舒适性、容错率与灵活操控。球拍采用275克空拍重量、320毫米平衡点及16×19线床，非常适合初学者和中级球员。其线床在核心甜区位置密度更高，而边缘区域更加开放，从而兼顾精准度、容错性与力量输出。整体风格轻盈、易打，并兼具 Lacoste 标志性的设计感。

description.en: The Tecnifibre FIRE 260 OS is the lightest and most forgiving model in the FIRE range. Featuring a 110 sq.in oversize head, 260 g unstrung weight, 330 mm balance and a 16x19 string pattern, it delivers effortless power, exceptional comfort and a very large sweet spot. X-DAMP technology reduces harmful vibration by approximately 36%, helping protect the arm while maintaining excellent comfort. The revised frame geometry and centralized weight distribution improve racket-head acceleration, making it an ideal choice for beginners, club players, doubles specialists and developing juniors.
description.zh: Tecnifibre FIRE 260 OS 是 FIRE 系列中最轻量、容错率最高的一款球拍，采用110平方英寸超大拍面、260克空拍重量、330毫米平衡点及16×19开放式线床。超大甜区能够有效提升击球容错率，并轻松提供更多力量，非常适合俱乐部球员、双打球员及青少年进阶使用。X-DAMP 技术可减少约36%的有害震动，进一步保护手臂并提升舒适性。相比上一代，拍框截面更加方正且整体薄约5%，重量更加集中，使拍头加速更加轻松，是一支极易上手且拥有优秀舒适性的现代化 Oversize 球拍。

description.en: The Tecnifibre FIRE 270 is the lightest and most maneuverable racket in the FIRE range. Featuring a 100 sq.in head, 270 g unstrung weight, 330 mm balance and a 16x19 string pattern, it is designed for club players and young competitors seeking effortless power and fast handling. X-DAMP technology, developed with TecniLab, reduces harmful vibration by approximately 36%, improving comfort and reducing arm fatigue. Compared with the previous generation, the frame is approximately 5% thinner with a more square profile, while weight has been centralized to improve racket-head acceleration and modern swing speed.
description.zh: Tecnifibre FIRE 270 是 FIRE 系列中最轻、最灵活的一款球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、270克空拍重量、330毫米平衡点及16×19开放式线床，主要面向俱乐部球员、青少年比赛球员及进阶初学者。X-DAMP 技术由 TecniLab 开发，通过手柄内部钢制阻尼系统减少约36%的有害震动，大幅提升舒适性并降低手臂疲劳。相比上一代，拍框截面更接近方形且整体薄约5%，重量分布更加集中，使拍头加速更快，更符合现代网球对快速挥拍和轻松发力的需求。

description.en: The Tecnifibre FIRE 285 is positioned as the balance point between power and maneuverability in the FIRE range. Featuring a 100 sq.in head, 285 g unstrung weight, 325 mm balance and a 16x19 string pattern, it is designed for club competitors and improving players who want easier handling without giving up useful mass and shot penetration. X-DAMP technology reduces harmful vibration by approximately 36%, while the revised frame geometry and centralized weight distribution improve stability, power control and racquet-head acceleration.
description.zh: Tecnifibre FIRE 285 是 FIRE 系列中兼顾力量与操控性的均衡型号，采用100平方英寸拍面、285克空拍重量、325毫米平衡点及16×19开放式线床。相比更轻的 FIRE 270，它拥有更好的击球厚重感与稳定性；相比 FIRE 300，则更容易挥动。X-DAMP 技术可减少约36%的有害震动，提升舒适性并降低手臂疲劳。拍框截面更加方正且整体薄约5%，重量分布也更加集中，从而提升稳定性、力量控制和拍头加速能力，非常适合俱乐部比赛球员及中高级进阶玩家。

description.en: The Tecnifibre FIRE 300 is the most power-oriented model in the FIRE range, combining explosive performance, comfort and easy acceleration. It features a 100 sq.in head, 300 g unstrung weight, 320 mm balance and a 16x19 string pattern. X-DAMP technology uses a steel component housed in an elastomer pocket inside the handle to counter impact vibration, reducing harmful vibration by 36% and helping reduce arm fatigue. Compared with the previous generation, the frame sections are more square and approximately 5% thinner to improve stability and power control, while weight has been redistributed toward the center of the frame to reduce swingweight and improve racquet-head acceleration.
description.zh: Tecnifibre FIRE 300 是 FIRE 系列中最偏力量输出的型号，强调爆发力、舒适性与快速挥拍。球拍采用100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量、320毫米平衡点及16×19开放式线床。核心 X-DAMP 技术通过在手柄内部设置钢制部件与弹性体结构，使其在击球时产生反向运动，从而减少约36%的有害震动并降低手臂疲劳。相比上一代，拍框截面更接近方形且整体薄约5%，以提升稳定性和力量控制，同时将重量从拍框两端重新分配至中心区域，降低挥重并提升拍头加速能力。整体非常适合现代底线进攻型球员。

description.en: The Tecnifibre FIRE 305S is the top competition model in the FIRE range, combining controllable power, maximum maneuverability and exceptional comfort. It features a 98 sq.in head, 305 g unstrung weight, 315 mm balance and open 16x19 string pattern. X-DAMP technology uses a steel component inside an elastomer pocket in the handle to move against impact vibrations, reducing harmful vibration by 36% and helping reduce arm fatigue. Compared with the previous FIRE generation, the frame sections are more square and approximately 12% thinner, while weight has been redistributed toward the center of the frame to reduce swingweight and improve racquet-head acceleration.
description.zh: Tecnifibre FIRE 305S 是 FIRE 系列中面向高水平竞技球员的旗舰型号，强调可控力量、快速操控与高舒适性。球拍采用98平方英寸拍面、305克空拍重量、315毫米平衡点及16×19开放式线床。核心 X-DAMP 技术通过在手柄内部设置钢制部件与弹性体结构，使其在击球时产生反向运动，从而减少约36%的有害震动并降低手臂疲劳。相比上一代 FIRE，拍框截面更接近方形且整体薄约12%，同时将重量从拍框两端向中心重新分配，以降低挥重并提升拍头加速能力，使其更符合现代网球对快速挥拍与高效率击球的需求。

description.en: The Tecnifibre T-FIGHT 300 IG is a modern performance racquet featuring a 100 sq.in head, 300 g unstrung weight, 320 mm balance and a 16x19 string pattern. Designed around the demands of today's faster game, it combines easy acceleration, excellent spin potential and balanced power with the RS Section frame and Isoflex technologies.
description.zh: Tecnifibre T-FIGHT 300 IG 是一款现代竞技型球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量、320毫米平衡点及16×19线床。为了适应现代网球越来越快的节奏，Tecnifibre 重新优化了重量分布，降低挥拍惯性，使拍头加速更加轻松。RS Section 拍框结构兼顾力量与控制，而 Isoflex 技术进一步优化甜区与击球稳定性，使其成为一支兼具力量、旋转、操控与挥拍速度的现代化球拍。

description.en: The Tecnifibre T-FIGHT 300S is a modern 98 sq.in performance racquet designed to balance power, control, spin and maneuverability. Weighing 300 g unstrung with a 16x19 string pattern, it reflects Tecnifibre's modern swing-speed philosophy by redistributing weight toward the center of the frame to improve racquet-head acceleration. RS Section geometry blends square and round frame profiles to balance power and control, while Isoflex progressive stiffness expands the effective sweet spot and helps maintain precision on off-center contact.
description.zh: Tecnifibre T-FIGHT 300S 是一款现代98平方英寸竞技型球拍，采用300克空拍重量及16×19线床，在力量、控制、旋转和灵活操控之间取得优秀平衡。其设计核心围绕现代网球更快的挥拍速度展开，通过重新分配拍框重量，让拍头更容易加速。RS Section 将方形与圆形拍框结构融合，以兼顾力量与控制；Isoflex 渐进式刚性系统则扩大有效甜区，使非中心击球依然保持良好的精准度与稳定性。

description.en: The Tecnifibre T-FIGHT 300S IG is a special Iga Swiatek-inspired event edition celebrating her connection with Paris and Roland Garros. Its orange and electric-yellow cosmetic references clay-court tennis, while details such as the four-star Eiffel Tower motif and Swiatek's 'you did not wake up to be ordinary' motto connect the design directly to her Paris achievements. Performance-wise, the racquet uses a 98 sq.in head, 300 g unstrung weight, 320 mm balance and 16x19 string pattern, combining power, control, spin and fast handling. RS Section geometry blends square and round frame profiles, while Isoflex varies stiffness around the head to optimize sweet spot response and stability.
description.zh: Tecnifibre T-FIGHT 300S IG 是一款以 Iga Swiatek 与巴黎、Roland Garros 深厚联系为主题的特别版球拍。橙色主调与电光黄色细节象征红土场地与网球弹跳，四颗星组成的埃菲尔铁塔图案代表她在巴黎的四次夺冠，同时保留其标志性格言“you did not wake up to be ordinary”。性能方面，这支球拍采用98平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量、320毫米平衡点及16×19线床，在力量、控制、旋转与挥拍速度之间取得平衡。RS Section 将传统方形与圆形拍框结构融合，而 Isoflex 通过拍框不同区域的渐进刚性优化甜区、稳定性与击球反馈。

description.en: The Tecnifibre T-FIGHT TEAM is a more accessible and forgiving version of the T-FIGHT concept, designed for regular and occasional players seeking power, spin and comfort. It features a 102 sq.in head, 285 g weight, 330 mm balance and a 16x19 string pattern. The larger RSX Section frame provides additional power compared with the standard T-FIGHT range, while Isoflex progressive stiffness enlarges the sweet spot and helps maintain consistent power and precision on both centered and off-center contact. The racquet is factory pre-strung with black synthetic gut and is ready to play.
description.zh: Tecnifibre T-FIGHT TEAM 是标准 T-FIGHT 系列更容易驾驭、更高容错的版本，主要面向日常及休闲比赛球员。球拍采用102平方英寸拍面、285克重量、330毫米平衡点及16×19线床，在力量、旋转、舒适性与易打性之间取得优秀平衡。更大的 RSX Section 拍框结构相比标准 T-FIGHT 提供更多力量，而 Isoflex 渐进式刚性系统能够扩大甜区，使中心及非中心击球都保持较稳定的力量与精准度。该产品原厂预穿黑色 Synthetic Gut，可直接使用。

description.en: The Tecnifibre T-FIGHT TOUR 26 2025 is a 26-inch junior performance racquet designed for competitive players aged approximately 10 to 12. It features a 100 sq.in head, 250 g unstrung weight, 330 mm balance and an open 16x17 string pattern, delivering an effective blend of power, control and spin. Its 100% graphite construction provides a premium feel, while the lightweight setup helps young players develop technique, racquet-head speed and confidence before transitioning to a full-size adult racquet.
description.zh: Tecnifibre T-FIGHT TOUR 26 2025 是一款面向约10至12岁竞技型青少年的26英寸高性能球拍。采用100平方英寸拍面、250克空拍重量、330毫米平衡点及16×17开放式线床，在力量、控制与旋转之间取得良好平衡。100%石墨结构提供更专业的击球反馈，而轻量化设计则有助于青少年球员学习完整动作、提升拍头速度，并顺利过渡到成人全尺寸球拍。

description.en: The Tecnifibre TEMPO 265 V2 is a lightweight women's performance racquet designed for regular, recreational and developing players. It features a 102 sq.in head, 265 g unstrung weight, shortened 67.5 cm frame and a 16x19 string pattern. X-SHORT technology reduces overall bulk and helps improve racquet-head acceleration, while the larger 102 sq.in head provides additional power and forgiveness. Its lightweight construction also makes it suitable for younger players transitioning toward adult racquets.
description.zh: Tecnifibre TEMPO 265 V2 是一款专为女性球员设计的轻量化高性能球拍，主要面向日常、休闲及成长型球员。球拍采用102平方英寸拍面、265克空拍重量、67.5厘米缩短拍长及16×19线床。X-SHORT 技术通过缩短拍身减少挥拍阻力，使拍头更容易加速；102平方英寸大拍面则提供更大的甜区、更轻松的力量输出及更高容错率。轻量化设计也非常适合正在向成人球拍过渡的年轻球员。

description.en: The Tecnifibre TEMPO 270 V2 is a women's performance racquet developed specifically around female biomechanics. It features a 100 sq.in head, 270 g unstrung weight and a shortened 67.5 cm frame using X-SHORT technology to improve maneuverability and racquet-head acceleration. Combined with ISOFLEX and Superlight Cap technologies, the racquet delivers effortless power, increased spin and a larger sweet spot while remaining exceptionally easy to swing.
description.zh: Tecnifibre TEMPO 270 V2 是专为女性球员人体工学打造的高性能球拍。采用100平方英寸拍面、270克空拍重量以及67.5厘米加速型拍长，配合 X-SHORT 技术降低挥拍惯性，使拍头更容易加速。ISOFLEX 技术扩大甜区，而 Superlight Cap 则进一步减轻拍头重量，提升挥拍速度与灵活性。整体拥有优秀的力量输出、旋转能力及舒适手感，非常适合女性球员、青少年以及希望使用轻量球拍的俱乐部球员。

description.en: The Tecnifibre TF-40 290 16M V3 is the lightest and fastest model in the TF-40 family. Featuring a 98 sq.in head, 290 g unstrung weight and a 16x19 string pattern, it delivers excellent maneuverability while maintaining the TF-40 signature precision. RS Sharp Section optimizes frame flex for directional control, the polyurethane foam-filled frame improves feel and comfort, and Extense BG grommets increase string movement and responsiveness on off-center shots.
description.zh: Tecnifibre TF-40 290 16M V3 是 TF-40 系列中最轻量、最容易挥动的一款控制型球拍。采用98平方英寸拍面、290克空拍重量及16×19线床，在保持 TF-40 系列精准控制手感的同时，大幅提升拍头加速能力。RS Sharp Section 优化击球时拍框弯曲，提升线路控制；整支拍框内部填充聚氨酯泡沫，提高舒适性与扎实击球感；Extense BG 线孔增强球线活动空间，使非甜区击球依然保持良好的反馈与旋转能力。

description.en: The Tecnifibre TF-40 305 16M V3 is the most balanced model in the TF-40 range for players seeking precision with greater maneuverability and spin access. It features a 98 sq.in head, 305 g unstrung weight and a 16x19 string pattern that is tighter in the center to preserve control while allowing more spin than the 18x20 version. RS Sharp Section geometry optimizes frame flex at impact, the fully foamed polyurethane construction improves feel and shock absorption, and Exte​​nse BG grommets increase string movement and responsiveness on off-center contact.
description.zh: Tecnifibre TF-40 305 16M V3 是 TF-40 系列中在操控性与旋转之间最均衡的型号。它采用98平方英寸拍面、305克空拍重量及16×19线床，并在核心甜区采用相对更紧密的线床布局，在保持精准控制的同时提供比18×20版本更好的旋转潜力。RS Sharp Section 拍框结构优化击球瞬间的拍框弯曲，整支拍框内部填充聚氨酯泡沫以提升减震与扎实手感，而 Exte​​nse BG 线孔则增强球线活动空间与非甜区击球时的响应。整体非常适合希望兼顾控制、旋转与灵活性的高级竞技球员。

description.en: The Tecnifibre TF-40 305 18M V3 is a precision-focused control racquet designed for advanced players seeking the best balance between maneuverability and maximum directional control. It features a 98 sq.in head, 305 g unstrung weight and a dense 18x20 string pattern for exceptional consistency and reduced string movement. RS Sharp Section geometry optimizes frame flex at impact to preserve trajectory control, the polyurethane foam-filled frame improves comfort and feel, and Extense BG grommets help maintain responsiveness on off-center contact.
description.zh: Tecnifibre TF-40 305 18M V3 是一款面向高级及比赛型球员的精准控制型球拍，在灵活操控与极致控制之间取得优秀平衡。采用98平方英寸拍面、305克空拍重量及18×20密集线床，能够提供非常稳定的击球轨迹、优秀的方向控制，并减少球线移动与断线概率。RS Sharp Section 拍框结构优化击球瞬间的拍框弯曲，以维持稳定的线路控制；整支拍框内部填充聚氨酯泡沫，提升减震表现与扎实手感；Extense BG 加宽加长线孔则帮助球线保持一定活动空间，使偏心击球仍具有良好响应。

description.en: The Tecnifibre TF-40 315 16M V3 is the most stable spin-friendly model in the TF-40 lineup. Featuring a 98 sq.in head, 315 g unstrung weight and a center-tight 16x19 string pattern, it combines exceptional stability with modern spin potential. RS Sharp Section geometry preserves directional precision, the polyurethane foam-filled frame delivers a solid and comfortable impact feel, and Extense BG grommets improve string movement and responsiveness on off-center shots. It is designed for advanced competitors who want maximum stability without sacrificing spin.
description.zh: Tecnifibre TF-40 315 16M V3 是 TF-40 系列中兼具最高稳定性与现代旋转能力的版本。采用98平方英寸拍面、315克空拍重量及16×19线床，在保持扎实击球感的同时，比18×20版本更容易制造旋转。RS Sharp Section 拍框结构优化击球轨迹控制；整支拍框内部填充聚氨酯泡沫，带来优秀的减震表现与扎实手感；Extense BG 加宽线孔则提高球线活动空间，使非甜区击球依然保持稳定反馈。这是一支适合高水平竞技球员、强调稳定击球与旋转兼顾的现代控制型球拍。

description.en: The Tecnifibre TF-40 315 18M V3 is the most control- and stability-focused model in the TF-40 family. It features a 98 sq.in head, 315 g unstrung weight and a dense 18x20 string pattern for maximum directional precision and consistency. RS Sharp Section geometry optimizes frame flex at impact to preserve trajectory control while still delivering useful power. The frame is fully filled with polyurethane foam to absorb shock and create the signature TF-40 feel, while Exte​​nse BG grommets improve string movement and maintain responsiveness on off-center hits.
description.zh: Tecnifibre TF-40 315 18M V3 是 TF-40 系列中最强调控制与稳定性的型号，采用98平方英寸拍面、315克空拍重量及18×20密集线床，为高水平球员提供极高的线路精准度与击球一致性。RS Sharp Section 拍框结构通过优化击球瞬间的拍框弯曲，在保持轨迹控制的同时提供适度力量；整支拍框内部填充聚氨酯泡沫，有效吸收冲击并形成 TF-40 标志性的扎实手感；Extense BG 线孔则通过更宽、更长的结构，让球线拥有更好的活动空间，从而提升非甜区击球时的响应与容错。

description.en: The Yonex EZONE 100 Blast Blue 2025 delivers explosive power, excellent comfort and an easy-to-use response, making it one of the most versatile modern racquets for intermediate and advanced players.
description.zh: Yonex EZONE 100 Blast Blue 2025 采用100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量、320mm平衡点及16×19线床，拥有出色的力量输出、舒适性与容错率，是适合现代底线打法及全场型球员的经典100拍面球拍。

description.en: The Yonex EZONE 100L Blast Blue 2025 is a lightweight performance racquet designed for effortless power, exceptional comfort and fast maneuverability. It is ideal for improving players looking for an easy-to-use all-court racquet.
description.zh: Yonex EZONE 100L Blast Blue 2025 采用100平方英寸拍面、285克空拍重量、325mm平衡点及16×19线床，结合 ISOMETRIC、LINER TECH、O.P.S.、Shockless Grommets、2G-Namd Speed、MINOLON 与 VDM 等技术，提供舒适手感、轻松力量及优秀容错率，非常适合希望提升击球质量的初中阶与进阶球员。

description.en: The Yonex EZONE 100SL Blast Blue 2025 is an ultra-light performance racquet offering exceptional comfort, effortless power and easy maneuverability for beginners and improving players.
description.zh: Yonex EZONE 100SL Blast Blue 2025 采用100平方英寸拍面、270克空拍重量、330mm平衡点及16×18线床，结合 ISOMETRIC、LINER TECH、O.P.S.、Shockless Grommets、2G-Namd Speed、MINOLON 与 VDM 等技术，提供极佳舒适性、轻松力量及超高容错率，非常适合初学者、女性球员及希望降低挥拍负担的球员。

description.en: The Yonex EZONE 98 Blast Blue 2025 blends explosive power, outstanding comfort and modern control, making it one of the most versatile performance racquets for advanced players.
description.zh: Yonex EZONE 98 Blast Blue 2025 是 Yonex 最受欢迎的现代力量型球拍之一，拥有305克空拍重量、98平方英寸拍面及16×19线床，在爆发力、舒适性及稳定性之间取得极佳平衡，非常适合进攻型底线球员与全场型球员。

description.en: The Yonex EZONE 98 TOUR Blast Blue 2025 is a tour-level racquet built for advanced players seeking explosive power, exceptional stability and penetrating ball speed while maintaining the renowned EZONE comfort.
description.zh: Yonex EZONE 98 TOUR Blast Blue 2025 采用98平方英寸拍面、315克空拍重量及16×19线床，是EZONE系列中最具职业竞技属性的版本之一，兼具爆发力、稳定性与舒适击球感，非常适合高水平进攻型球员及赛事选手。

description.en: The Yonex EZONE 98L Blast Blue 2025 is a lightweight performance racquet offering easy power, excellent comfort and fast maneuverability for intermediate and improving advanced players.
description.zh: Yonex EZONE 98L Blast Blue 2025 采用98平方英寸拍面、285克空拍重量及16×19线床，提供轻松挥拍、充足力量与舒适击球感，非常适合进阶型球员、女性球员及希望提升挥拍速度的使用者。

description.en: The Yonex EZONE Alpha Blast Blue 2025 is a lightweight and forgiving racquet designed for recreational and improving players seeking effortless power, comfort and easy handling.
description.zh: Yonex EZONE Alpha Blast Blue 2025 采用100平方英寸拍面、275克空拍重量、330mm平衡点及16×18线床，结合 ISOMETRIC、LINER TECH、O.P.S.、Shockless Grommets、2G-Namd Speed、MINOLON 与 VDM 技术，拥有轻松的击球力量、优秀的舒适性及极高容错率，非常适合初学者、休闲球员及希望提升挥拍速度的进阶球员。

description.en: The Yonex MUSE 100 is a comfort-oriented 100 sq.in racquet featuring a 295 g unstrung weight, 330 mm balance and an open 16x18 string pattern. It offers easy power, excellent comfort and generous spin potential, making it suitable for a wide range of recreational and intermediate players.
description.zh: Yonex MUSE 100 采用100平方英寸拍面、295克空拍重量、330毫米平衡点及16×18开放式线床设计，提供出色的舒适性、轻松发力与良好的旋转能力，非常适合休闲及中级球员使用。

description.en: The Yonex MUSE 100L 2026 is a lightweight comfort-oriented racquet featuring a 100 sq.in head, 280 g unstrung weight, 325 mm balance and a 16x18 string pattern. It offers excellent comfort, effortless power and easy maneuverability for developing and intermediate players.
description.zh: Yonex MUSE 100L 2026 是一款轻量化舒适型网球拍，采用100平方英寸拍面、280克空拍重量、325毫米平衡点及16×18开放式线床设计。拥有优秀的舒适性、轻松发力、较高的容错率和良好的旋转表现，非常适合初学者、女性球员以及中级球员使用。

description.en: The Yonex MUSE 100SL 2026 is the lightest model in the MUSE family, featuring a 100 sq.in head, 265 g unstrung weight, 330 mm balance and a 16x18 string pattern. It delivers outstanding comfort, effortless maneuverability and easy power, making it ideal for beginners, junior players, women and recreational players seeking a lightweight performance racquet.
description.zh: Yonex MUSE 100SL 2026 是 MUSE 系列中最轻量化的型号，采用100平方英寸拍面、265克空拍重量、330毫米平衡点及16×18开放式线床设计。具备极佳的舒适性、轻松挥拍能力及良好的发力表现，非常适合初学者、女性球员、青少年以及希望降低挥拍负担的休闲球员。

description.en: The Yonex OSAKA EZONE 98 Gold/Purple Limited Edition was created in collaboration with Naomi Osaka and Mari Osaka as a special cosmetic version of the 7th-generation EZONE 98. Its design features dragons and spider lilies, symbolizing strength, beauty, power and fighting spirit. Performance remains based on the power-and-comfort focused EZONE 98 platform.
description.zh: Yonex OSAKA EZONE 98 Gold/Purple Limited Edition 是 Naomi Osaka 与其姐姐 Mari Osaka 联合 Yonex 研发团队共同设计的限定版本，以第7代 EZONE 98 为性能基础。球拍采用金色与紫色配色，并融入龙与彼岸花元素，象征力量、好运、坚韧、美丽与战斗精神。其性能定位仍延续 EZONE 98 的力量与舒适特性，主要区别在于限定联名外观及收藏属性。

description.en: The Yonex PERCEPT 100 Midnight Navy 2025 combines classic control with a more forgiving 100 sq.in head, making it ideal for intermediate to advanced players seeking precision, comfort and versatility.
description.zh: Yonex PERCEPT 100 Midnight Navy 2025 拥有100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量及16×19线床，在保留 PERCEPT 系列优秀手感和控制力的同时，提供更高的容错率，非常适合进阶及高级球员进行全场打法。

description.en: The Yonex PERCEPT 100L Midnight Navy 2025 is a lightweight control racquet offering excellent comfort, maneuverability and forgiveness, making it ideal for improving intermediate players and doubles specialists.
description.zh: Yonex PERCEPT 100L Midnight Navy 2025 采用100平方英寸拍面、280克空拍重量及16×19线床设计，在保持 PERCEPT 系列出色手感的同时，大幅提升挥拍速度与容错率，非常适合成长型球员、双打选手及希望减轻手臂负担的球员。

description.en: The Yonex PERCEPT 97 Midnight Navy 2025 is designed for advanced players seeking exceptional precision, feel and stability. Its 97 sq.in head and 310 g weight deliver classic control with modern comfort.
description.zh: Yonex PERCEPT 97 Midnight Navy 2025 是一款专为高级球员打造的控制型球拍，拥有97平方英寸拍面、310克空拍重量以及优秀的击球手感，适合追求精准落点、稳定性和全场进攻能力的竞技型球员。

description.en: The Yonex PERCEPT 97D Midnight Navy 2025 is a tour-level control racquet featuring a dense 18x20 string pattern, exceptional directional precision and outstanding stability for advanced players.
description.zh: Yonex PERCEPT 97D Midnight Navy 2025 是PERCEPT系列中控制能力最强的版本之一，采用97平方英寸拍面、320克空拍重量及18×20线床设计，提供极高的落点精准度、稳定性与击球反馈，非常适合竞技级球员及高水平控制型打法。

description.en: The Yonex PERCEPT 97D Olive 2025 is a tour-level control racquet featuring the same performance specifications as the Midnight Navy version, finished in an exclusive Olive colorway.
description.zh: Yonex PERCEPT 97D Olive 2025 为 Olive 特别配色版本，与 Midnight Navy 版本拥有完全相同的性能规格。采用97平方英寸拍面、320克空拍重量、310mm平衡点及18×20线床，搭载 ISOMETRIC、SERVO FILTER、FLEXCON SYSTEM 与 2G-Namd Flex Force 技术，提供顶级精准控制、稳定性与细腻手感。

description.en: The Yonex PERCEPT 97H Olive 2025 is the heaviest model in the PERCEPT family, designed for professional players seeking maximum stability, precision and plow-through from a classic 97 square inch frame.
description.zh: Yonex PERCEPT 97H Olive 2025 是 PERCEPT 系列最重的职业版球拍，采用330克空拍重量、97平方英寸拍面、16×19线床及310mm平衡点，为高水平球员提供极佳的稳定性、穿透力、精准控制与击球质感。Olive 为特别配色版本。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 100+ Ruby Red 2026 features a 27.5-inch extended frame for additional leverage, heavier serves and explosive topspin. Designed for advanced players seeking maximum spin and power from the baseline.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 100+ Ruby Red 2026 采用27.5英寸加长拍身设计，在标准VCORE 100的基础上提供更大的杠杆效应、更高的发球速度以及更强的上旋能力，适合高级底线型球员和竞技比赛使用。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 100 Ruby Red 2026 is the most versatile model in the VCORE family, combining easy power, heavy spin and excellent maneuverability. It suits intermediate to advanced players looking for modern baseline performance with all-court versatility.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 100 Ruby Red 2026 是 VCORE 系列最全面、最容易驾驭的型号之一。100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量、320毫米平衡点及16×19线床，在力量、旋转、容错性及操控之间取得优秀平衡，非常适合现代底线打法及全场型球员。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 100D Ruby Red 2026 combines the forgiveness of a 100 sq.in head with an 18x19 string pattern for greater directional control and flatter ball trajectories. It is ideal for advanced players who want the spin of the VCORE family with improved precision.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 100D Ruby Red 2026 采用100平方英寸拍面、300克空拍重量、320毫米平衡点以及18×19线床。相比标准版VCORE 100拥有更密集的线床，提供更精准的落点控制、更低的击球弹道，同时依然保持VCORE系列优秀的旋转能力，非常适合高级及比赛型球员。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 100L Ruby Red 2026 offers the signature VCORE spin in a lightweight 280 g package. With a 100 sq.in head and 16x19 string pattern, it provides easy racquet acceleration, generous power and excellent comfort for improving intermediate players.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 100L Ruby Red 2026 采用100平方英寸拍面、280克空拍重量、330毫米平衡点以及16×19线床，是VCORE系列中最容易挥动的100拍面版本之一。它兼具优秀的旋转能力、舒适性及容错率，非常适合中级球员、青少年竞技球员以及希望提升挥拍速度的成年人。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 95 Ruby Red 2026 is the most control-oriented model in the VCORE family. Featuring a 95 sq.in head, 310 g unstrung weight, 310 mm balance and a 16x20 string pattern, it delivers exceptional precision, heavy spin potential and outstanding stability for advanced and professional players with fast swing speeds.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 95 Ruby Red 2026 是 VCORE 系列中控制性能最强的型号，采用95平方英寸拍面、310克空拍重量、310毫米平衡点及16×20线床设计。专为高水平及职业球员打造，能够提供极高的精准度、强烈的旋转能力以及卓越的击球稳定性，非常适合挥拍速度快、主动进攻型球员。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 98+ Ruby Red 2026 features a 27.5-inch extended frame for increased leverage, heavier ball penetration and greater serving power while maintaining the signature VCORE spin performance. Designed for advanced players with long, fast swings.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 98+ Ruby Red 2026 采用27.5英寸加长拍身设计，在保留VCORE系列高旋转特性的同时，提供更大的发球优势、更强的击球穿透力以及更重的来球质量。适合高级及职业球员，尤其适合拥有大幅度挥拍动作、希望提升发球和底线攻击力的使用者。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 98 Ruby Red 2026 combines explosive spin, controllable power and excellent maneuverability. Its 98 sq.in head, 305 g weight and 16x19 string pattern make it an ideal choice for advanced players seeking aggressive baseline performance with all-court versatility.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 98 Ruby Red 2026 是 VCORE 系列最均衡的旗舰型号，采用98平方英寸拍面、305克空拍重量、315毫米平衡点及16×19线床。兼具强烈旋转、可控力量与灵活操控，非常适合高级及竞技型球员进行现代底线进攻，同时也具备优秀的全场能力。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 98 TOUR Ruby Red 2026 is designed for advanced tournament players seeking maximum stability, precision and spin. With a 315 g unstrung weight and 98 sq.in head, it delivers exceptional plow-through and heavy ball production.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 98 TOUR Ruby Red 2026 是 VCORE 系列中最偏竞技比赛定位的版本，采用98平方英寸拍面、315克空拍重量、325毫米平衡点以及16×19线床。相比标准版拥有更高的稳定性、更重的击球质量以及更精准的控制能力，适合高水平及职业比赛球员使用。

description.en: The Yonex VCORE 98L Ruby Red 2026 offers the signature VCORE spin with a lighter 285 g frame for improved maneuverability and comfort. Designed for intermediate to advanced players seeking fast racquet speed and easy access to topspin.
description.zh: Yonex VCORE 98L Ruby Red 2026 采用98平方英寸拍面、285克空拍重量、325毫米平衡点及16×19线床，在保留VCORE系列旋转性能的同时，提供更轻盈、更灵活的挥拍体验。适合希望提升旋转与击球速度的中高级球员。
